pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 100
   C. 10
   D. 11

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 7

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

5. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 1

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

10. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

11. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 8
   D. 7

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 9

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

17. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

19. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 45
   D. 36

21. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

24. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 22
   C. 14
   D. 28

25. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

26. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 50

27. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

28. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

29. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

30. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 72
